name: OpenFlights
tagline: Open airline, airport, and route datasets for aviation apps
description: OpenFlights documents downloadable CSV-format airport, airline, route, plane, and country datasets. Files served from raw.githubusercontent.com are sporadically updated static snapshots of the live database. Route data stopped updating in June 2014 and is historical only.

auth.details: No authentication required; data files are publicly downloadable

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free data downloads; unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads may be rate-limited by GitHub, with no numeric threshold published.

rate_limits: GitHub rate-limits unauthenticated raw.githubusercontent.com downloads; no numeric threshold is officially published.
use_cases: look up airport coordinates by IATA code from airports.dat
build airline route graphs from routes.dat
resolve airline names and ICAO codes from airlines.dat
seed local aviation reference DBs for flight apps
map airport timezones for schedule UIs
